register.labelZh: BACK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: BACK 片語動詞可以表示某人向後退、車輛倒後移動,或建築物後方連接某處。；back away from、back down、back off 和 back out 可以分別表示因困難而退縮、讓步、停止施壓或退出安排。；back somebody up 可以表示支持某人;back a story up 可以表示證實某個說法。；你可以 back up files 來保護工作檔案,也可以用 traffic is backing up 表示車輛排成長龍。
register.summaryEn: BACK expressions can show someone moving away, a vehicle moving backwards, or a building having a particular place behind it. back away from, back down, back off and back out describe different ways of retreating from an action, position, demand or arrangement. back somebody up can show support for a person. Backing a story up means showing that it is true. You can back up files to protect your work. You can also say that traffic is backing up when vehicles form a long queue.
contextsZh: 談論數碼安全和道路情況
contextsEn: Talk about difficult decisions and pressure
Talk about digital safety and road problems
